texts.work: Iordanes, De summa temporum vel origine actibusque gentis Romanorum (Romana)

sigla.manuscript: Parisinus lat. 4860 (from lost Augiensis; recensio rejected, cited rarely)
Florus (source), Paulus Diaconus, Frechulfus (testimonia in lower margin)

evidence.quote: nam in Romanis cum praeter excerpta Cheltenhamensia non adsint nisi primi ordinis libri, res facilis est et expedita.
Item in Romanis, quae tertius ordo non habet, ex secundo sola excerpta Phillippsiana.
neque absimile veri est archetypum Laurentiani diversum fuisse ab archetypo librorum HPV et quibusdam locis minus corruptum.

texts.notes: The p. LXXII stemma is stated for the Getica; for the Romana all direct codices are class I and class II survives only in excerpts (S), so the only direct top-level branch is class I. Within class I Mommsen hedges that L derives from an archetype different from that of HPV ('neque absimile veri'); this is the only internal split. Not a pilot text.

Vindobonensis 203 (contaminated from classes II and I; cited occasionally)
Paulus Diaconus Hist. Rom., Frechulfus, Landolfus Sagax (excerpts, lower margin)

evidence.quote: nam stemma codicum, quod ex supra positis efficitur, hoc fere est: archetypum commune | archetypum ordinum primi et secundi | archetypum ordinis tertii | archetypum ordinis primi | archetypum ordinis secundi

libera electio est non solum ibi, ubi tres ordines dissentiunt, sed ibi quoque, ubi ab una parte stant HPVLASOB contra XYZ: e contrario ubicumque aut HPVLAXYZ stant contra SOB aut SOBXYZ contra HPVLA, classis solitaria vincitur.
ex corruptela in archetypo primi secundique ei substituta ... natae sunt lectiones interpolatae ambae classis secundae ouium, classis primae ouium auiumque.
habuit igitur codicis Ambrosiani librarius archetypum optimis accensendum aut ipsum Palatinum aut gemellum eius

texts.notes: Stemma diagram (p. LXXII) OCR-garbled but its node labels survive and the following sentence (HPVLASOB vs XYZ) confirms the top split: classes I+II under a common sub-archetype vs class III. S (Phillipps epitome) is class II but excerpts; Vind. 203 contaminated I/II. Check Y/Z siglum assignment (Y=Cantabrigiensis, Z=Berolinensis) against the notarum index image.

evidence.quote: Duo sunt codicum genera, quibus Ausonii opuscula ad nostram memoriam pervenerunt. utroque non omnes Ausonii libelli continentur, sed excerpta ex corpore ampliore.
ceterum Parisinum et Vossianum ex communi fonte fluxisse scripturae in utroque consensus ostendit.
Prius codicum genus: T Tilianus ... M Magliabecchianus ... Alterum codicum genus: V Vossianus 111 ... P Parisinus 8500

texts.notes: Schenkl divides witnesses into two genera, but each is an anthology of different opuscula drawn from a fuller corpus; the 'alterum genus' lumps the V/P florilegium, the Paulinus codices and a separate Mosella/Caesares florilegium (G B W) with no common sub-archetype asserted. No single stemma; witness sets differ poem by poem, so any top division must be set per opusculum. Several OCR sigla in the index (lines 33092-33200) are garbled.
